summary: Describes how to use the CMC certificate management protocol when managing certificates for the US government's NSA Suite B cryptography policy. It narrows the choices in RFC 5272, RFC 5273 and RFC 5274 to the algorithms that policy allows. It is informational, and its status is now historic.

eli5.summary: The government once published a short list of approved secret-code methods. This explains how to get computer ID cards using only methods on that list. It is now old and kept for history.
